outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed in frame 0 (image, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle through frames 40–96, with handle engagement visible in wrist_image at frames 97–114. It then pulls the drawer outward: frames 120–138 show increasing extension in image and left_ego_image. The drawer remains visibly open through frame 162 as the gripper releases the handle (wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
